common.network_error: Network request failed. Please check your connection.

version.required: The version of the item is missing; reload it and try again.

value.invalid_format: This value has the wrong format (expected {expected}).
value.too_long: This value is too long (at most {max}).
value.too_short: This value is too short (at least {min}).

common.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

cursor.invalid: The page position is no longer valid; reload the list.

common.rate_limited: Too many requests; try again in {retryAfterSeconds} s.

sort.invalid_field: The list cannot be sorted by {field}.

time.invalid_local: The local time {local} does not exist or is ambiguous ({reason}).

common.unavailable: A service is unavailable ({dependency}); try again later.

package.signature_invalid: The package signature does not match its manifest ({reason}).
package.untrusted_key: The package is signed with an untrusted key ({keyId}).
package.hash_mismatch: The file {file} does not match the hash listed in the manifest.
package.file_unlisted: The file {file} is not listed in the manifest.
package.contract_unsupported: The package requires integration contract {required}; this version supports {runtime}.
package.product_too_old: The package requires Watchpoint {required} or later (installed: {product}).
package.platform_unsupported: The package does not support this platform ({platform}).
package.shared_assembly_shadowed: The package ships its own copy of the shared assembly {assembly}; the host's copy is used.
package.unreadable: The package could not be read ({reason}).
package.file_missing: The package file {file} is missing; connections still use this version.
package.reserved_id: The package id {package} is reserved for Watchpoint packages.
package.file_name_invalid: The file name {fileName} is not allowed; use name.wpkg.

target.orphaned: Device {deviceId} is no longer reported by its system.

commands.not_supported: This device does not support the command {path}.
commands.outside_schedule: You may not run this command at this time.
commands.client_kind_not_allowed: This command cannot be run from this client ({clientKind}).

reason.required: A reason is required for this command.

connection.missing: Device {deviceId} has no connection to run commands.

not_before.too_far: A command can be scheduled at most {maxHours} hours ahead.

group.too_large: A group command can target at most {max} devices ({count} selected).

cancel.too_late: The command can no longer be cancelled ({state}).

approval.self_forbidden: You cannot approve your own command.
approval.not_pending: The command is not awaiting approval ({state}).

draft.not_open: Draft {draftId} is {status} and can no longer be changed.
draft.too_large: A draft can hold at most {max} changes.

entry.outdated: This object was changed by someone else after you started editing it (you edited version {baseVersion}, it is now version {liveVersion}).

reference.missing: This refers to {type} {id}, which does not exist or is deleted in this draft.
reference.in_use: This object is still used by {count} other objects and cannot be deleted.

publish.invalid: The draft has {errors} errors and cannot be published.
publish.conflict: Other changes were published since you started; resolve the conflicts first.
publish.in_progress: Another publish is in progress; try again in a moment.

approval.required: These changes need approval before they are published.
approval.self_forbidden: You cannot approve your own changes.

lock.held_by: This object is being edited by {user}.
lock.not_supported: This kind of object cannot be locked.

import.invalid_bundle: The file is not a valid configuration bundle.
import.unmapped_reference: The file refers to {type} {name}, which could not be matched.

licence.quota_exceeded: Your licence allows {allowed} {unit}; these changes would use {projected}.

secret.invalid: A secret value must be text.

client_kind.not_allowed: Configuration can only be changed from the desktop application.

idempotency.in_progress: The same request is still being processed.
idempotency.key_invalid: The idempotency key is invalid (1 to 64 letters, digits, - or _).
idempotency.mismatch: This idempotency key was already used for another request.

request.invalid: The request could not be read.
request.too_large: The request is too large (at most {max} bytes).
